citations.title: Wal-Mart de Mexico (WALMEX) Investor Relations, Earnings Summary & Outlook

sentences.text:
Walmart de Mexico y Centroamerica keeps gaining share in a weak consumer market, with second-quarter 2026 same-store sales up 1.8%, 180 basis points above the ANTAD self-service and club average.
eCommerce is the main growth engine: Mexico eCommerce net sales rose 16.2% in the quarter, led by On-Demand at 21.1%, and management targets tripling the eCommerce business over five years and 99% household coverage in Mexico.

sentences.quote:
Bait cerro el trimestre con 26.8 millones de usuarios activos, 25% mas que un ano antes.
Los ingresos del operador movil aumentaron 40%, hasta alcanzar 3,800 millones de pesos.
sentences.text: Higher-margin new businesses add optionality, as Walmart Connect advertising revenue grew 33% and Bait reached 26.6 million active users with revenues up 48%.
Physical expansion continues, with 14 new stores opened in Mexico in the first quarter of 2026, for 4,282 units in total.

sentences.quote: Full-year sales growth now expected between 3.5% and 4.5% in constant currency, with EBITDA margin slightly below last year.
sentences.text: The key risk is demand: full-year guidance was cut to 3.5%-4.5% constant-currency sales growth, with EBITDA margin seen slightly below last year.
